title: TikTok Reels YouTube Shorts Local Business Engagement
narration: This chart illustrates key statistics highlighting the growing impact of short-form video on consumer behavior and marketing effectiveness.  A significant 61% of consumers have made a purchase after seeing it in a short-form video, while 68% of TikTok users fall within the 18-34 age demographic, representing a valuable target audience. Furthermore, Reels account for 20% of Instagram’s content and YouTube Shorts contribute 17% of total YouTube watch time, demonstrating the widespread adoption and influence of these platforms.  These numbers underscore the importance of strategically leveraging short-form video for local businesses to drive engagement and sales.
